descriptionChirho: Adverb of manner indicating 'thus, so, in this way', the primary and overwhelmingly dominant sense of כֹּה, often introducing direct speech ('thus says the LORD') or referring to a described manner of action.
Spatial demonstrative adverb meaning 'here' or 'there' (hither/thither), often used in the paired expression כֹּה וָכֹּה 'here and there, on this side and that side'.
Temporal adverb meaning 'now, at this point', a rare extension of the demonstrative force of כֹּה from spatial proximity to temporal immediacy.
